summary: A Durango-resident kayaker was caught in the Trash Can area of Vallecito Creek, swam out, then fell while climbing out of the gorge and seriously injured his leg; Upper Pine Fire Protection District and La Plata County Search and Rescue set a technical rigging system, stabilized him on scene with a SAR physician and paramedics, and hauled him out of the gorge; the kayak was recovered.
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue
notes: Parent scope call: INCLUDED under the Telegraph chunk per the run-991 KMTS precedent — source is an American Whitewater reprint of a Durango Herald article (Ann Butler/Shane Benjamin, Friday May 20, 2016; Friday-verified), surfaced in the chunk's Vallecito keyword sweep, not a Telegraph item. Upper Pine Fire co-response; 21 people on scene; call ~2:15 p.m., kayaker out ~8:30 p.m.
